hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git add -A; git diff --cached --quiet && exit 0; n=$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l | tr -d ' '); list=$(git diff --cached --name-only | head -3 | xargs -n1 basename | paste -sd ', ' -); if [ "$n" -gt 3 ]; then msg="auto: ${n} files [${list}, +$((n-3))]"; else msg="auto: ${n} files [${list}]"; fi; git commit -m "$msg" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
